meta.triageRationale: Small bugfix routed issue -> build with no LLD (ISSUE-d6ba77b81bccfc4b).

body.focus: ISSUE-d6ba77b81bccfc4b: a session worker thread registers the analyze templates (registerBuiltinTemplates) and the analyze runtimes (registerBuiltinRuntimes) when it starts (src/daemon/threads/session-worker.ts), so the catalog and runtime registry it sees match the main thread's; with a test that a session worker thread has a non-empty template catalog (including docs templates) and a non-empty runtime registry.
body.summary: A session worker thread now registers the analyze templates (registerBuiltinTemplates) and runtimes (registerBuiltinRuntimes) at start, so analyze.run.start, which is served on a session worker, sees the same catalog and runtime registry as the main thread. A test op, test.analyzeRegistry, reports the worker's catalog and runtimes; the s3-acceptance test asserts 27+ templates, 6+ docs templates and non-empty runtimes, and fails (0 templates) with the registration removed.
